name: ODOS
summary: The limit-order router inherited a public ERC-6492 signature validator whose caller-controlled factory call could transfer router balances. The recorded transaction invoked that path ten times and drained ten assets; first-use and full campaign valuation remain under review.

loss.notes: Lower bound counts only source-1 USDC depletion at par. Nine other initial assets and later campaigns are unvalued here. Initial disposal reconciliation and later transfer-bearing calls are preserved in research/evidence/odos-review.json; the imported $50000 aggregate is removed.

ageReset.description: Direct runtime deployment; full first-use and campaign scope still under review.

limitations: Earliest unsafe validator exercise and full relevant history remain unresolved; source-3 preserves trace/receipt coordinates and next steps.

sources.note: Partial review, not promotion. Verified source https://basescan.org/address/0xb6333e994fd02a9255e794c177efbdeb1fe779c7#code has UniversalSigValidator.isValidSigImpl publicly executing the signature-supplied factory call with side effects permitted; no router-owner/config check. Source-1 callTracer reproduces ten direct calls with selector 0x16d43401 returning true. Its ten receipt transfers are preserved with exact raw amounts in research/evidence/odos-review.json. Source-4 receipt proves direct creation at block 24367565; eth_getCode at that block and 25431000 reproduces recorded runtime hash. Unresolved: earliest unsafe validator exercise, full later/sibling campaign scope, and valuation of all ten assets. Next: complete paginated router history beyond initial 10000 transactions (ending block 25302228), trace transfer-producing executions for unsafe validator calls, and reconcile attacker swaps through 0x6cb442acf35158d5eda88fe602221b67b400be3e plus bridge transaction 0xecd66a17fc6f585815c9fc53816aac16a9d52b240fed98989adfbc9ecb701238 to realized proceeds.

Initial-transaction disposal is fully reconciled in source-5: first nine transactions swap each non-WETH asset from source-1 for WETH; original WETH plus all nine outputs equals 11652820511872682507 raw WETH, exactly the final bridge transaction debit. USDC swap spends 15578334373 raw USDC for 4788675536932224044 raw WETH at block 25431144; its execution rate implies $37908.505791 for that initial basket, not the $50000 seed estimate. This is not full-episode loss. Source-6 identifies 33 later direct validator calls; receipts include further router balances and transferFrom legs from holders 0x08c504f1b3692df6a23fcd05d1d72cbbaa997b42, 0xee212c5fabb12721bd4a0640c4a467dece48193f and 0x98399d506a3e7e1ea268183a21f7915716fc7f56. Later token 0xc0d3700000987c99b3c9009069e4f8413fd22330 transfers originate at 0x785cada9f0e83998b366b33fcd43d0cdf7f6ffc3 and require attribution; failed and no-log calls are not assumed losses. Next: trace every source-6 leg to distinguish additional unauthorized depletion from authorized/probe activity, value merged campaigns, complete first-use trace scan and inspect indirect later calls. For independent USD valuation of realized WETH, Base Chainlink ETH/USD 0x71041dddad3595f9ced3dccfbe3d1f4b0a16bb70 decimals()=8; latestRoundData() at block 25431001 returns round 18446744073709654071, answer 325631000000, updatedAt 1737651189. Query the same feed at each source-5 disposal block instead of using one possibly slippage-affected swap price for the entire basket. The lower bound uses only the first transaction USDC at $1 per unit; no initial or later campaign inputs enter that transfer. research/evidence/odos-review.json records the 3336-transaction completed lexicographic scan prefix, input/coverage SHA-256 checksums, 26 later transfer-bearing calls, one revert, six no-depletion probes, disposal receipts and historical Chainlink rounds. This bounded scan does not prove earliest exercise.

limitations: Later validator calls in source-6 include additional depletion and unresolved attribution; initial disposal basket is not full-episode loss.
First successful exercise, indirect later calls and full campaign valuation remain unresolved; source-7 gives next steps.
